title: 花旗CEO直言：中国AI热情压过美国，制造引擎才是底牌
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Look, there's an enthusiasm for AI here, which, as we saw in the US election, that there's been less of a strong, positive sentiment in the States as there is in China.
segments.zh: 看，这里对AI充满热情，正如我们在美国大选中所见，美国的积极情绪不如中国强烈。

segments.en: And I think part of what you're seeing in China is this is the manufacturing engine of the world.
segments.zh: 我认为在中国看到的部分情况是，这里是世界制造业引擎。

segments.en: It should be no surprise, particularly of all the investments that have been made in energy, but we have to then see robotics, advanced engineering as well as the green tech, and now
segments.zh: 这并不意外，尤其是能源领域的所有投入，但我们必须看到机器人技术、先进工程以及绿色科技，现在

segments.en: so FinTech taking off and having multiple legs and dimensions to it, AI enabled.
segments.zh: 金融科技也在腾飞，具有多个分支和维度，AI赋能。

segments.en: And so it's quite complimentary in many ways to what we see in the US in terms of there it's more service, frontier model software prowess.
segments.zh: 因此，在很多方面，这与美国的情况相当互补，美国更侧重于服务、前沿模型软件实力。

segments.en: There are quite complimentary skills in AI, but no, there are certainly differences here, and a more positive sentiment towards it.
segments.zh: AI技能相当互补，但确实存在差异，且对AI的情绪更为积极。
